Model skeleton.description: A complete Verifpal model: attacker, two principals, a message and a query block.

Principal block.description: A block of operations performed by one principal.

Message.description: Send values from one principal to another.

Guarded message.description: Send a value the attacker may observe but not replace.

Phase.description: Open a new phase. Phases must increment by exactly one.

Queries block.description: The block of security queries. Nothing may follow it.

Scenarios block.description: Peer instantiation: one run of the model per line, with that line's bindings applied. Goes before the queries block.

Scenario instance.description: One scenario: the principal it instantiates, and the constants that run binds.

Confidentiality query.description: Can the attacker obtain this value?

Authentication query.description: Does the recipient rely on this value only if the sender sent it?

Freshness query.description: Is this value fresh between sessions? Detects replay.

Unlinkability query.description: Can the attacker tell these values share a source?

Equivalence query.description: Can these values ever fail to be equivalent?

Query with precondition.description: Annotate a failing query with a message that is sent anyway.

Diffie-Hellman exchange.description: Derive a public key and a Diffie-Hellman shared secret.

KEM encapsulation.description: Post-quantum key encapsulation: shared secret and ciphertext.

Authenticated encryption.description: Encrypt with associated data, and decrypt with a halting check.

Checked authenticated decryption.description: Decrypt, halting this principal if authentication fails.

Signature and verification.description: Sign a message, and verify it with a halting check.

Weakening assumption.description: Declare that a primitive at this call site is broken for the attacker.

Delayed weakening assumption.description: Declare an assumption that only comes into force from a later phase.
